title: Letter frequency pie with labels
intent: Identify each selected English letter around a frequency pie without relying on a separate legend.

source.title: Recharts Pie Chart With Customized Label

ai.create: Create a four-slice pie from Observable's alphabet rows with stable letter colors, radial leader lines, and one outside letter label per arc.
ai.maintain: Change the selected letters while preserving raw letter and frequency fields, source order, arc identity, responsive offsets, side-aware text anchors, and label-to-slice color.
